svg.title: CorvinOS system stack
svg.desc: Layered view: interfaces on top, router, engines as the external kernel, gates, plugin registry with boot layers, boot tripwire; memory on the left, the per-tenant audit chain as a spine on the right.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CorvinOS is the system layer around your agent

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The agent loop (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot CLI) stays unchanged — CorvinOS boots, routes, gates, remembers and records it.
